name: HighlightBench
description: Visual markups such as highlights, underlines, and bold text are common in table-centric documents. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in document understanding, their ability to treat such cues as explicit logical directives remains under-explored. More importantly, existing evaluations cannot distinguish whether a model fails to see the markup or fails to reason with it. This creates a key blind spot in assessing markup-conditioned behavior over tables.
